main_body: sci-fi wall face with trim, pipes, and vent
top_band: light slate cap row 0, dark shadow row 1, slate top header rows 2-4, orange trim rows 5-6
evidence: This is a terrain wall face strip (like the Beodeul wall references). It has a top cap/header (rows 0-6) and recessed panels/vents on the vertical wall face (rows 7-31) with top-lit ledges (row 21, 28) and inset vent/pipes.

style.evidence: The candidate consists almost entirely of large flat fills of solid slate-blue (e.g., rows 7-20 and 23-27 have solid unvaried blocks exceeding 10x10 pixels) with only 4 corner rivet dots per panel. Compared to the Beodeul wall references (which have rich plaster speckle, wood grain, or per-stone shading), the surface texture and tile information density are much lower and completely flat.
